entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,314 K and log g 0.92 (u1 0.828, u2 -0.008): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. Gravity: log g 0.92 from 2014AJ....147..137L; the 2 published values span log g 0.92 to 0.92, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.0% of the centre brightness.
